about: Who the outer road's part 2 people and animals are and what they do: every painted figure and animal of S4b (map/text/S4b.md, u 12600-15500) at its mapped spot (layout.json, with its recorded moves), and nobody else (map/BUILDING.md). Written by gen/sections/outer_road_2/make_people.py (the casting of gen/expand/outer_road_2_needs.md, from the 22 existing characters, at the area builder's real sizes); rerun it after a layout move, a build or a workshop delivery. figures: character (a character not made yet plays its stand_in; a seated figure whose character has no seated clip yet is played by the nearest look that can sit: cast_why), do = [clip, seconds] cycles with clips the playing character has (clips_why: what is still to make), nudge = [dX, dD] (nudge_why), facing_deg where the real-size scene needs another (facing_why), scale for children (scale_why), props = carried prop_<name> parts (props_why). The five crew stand on their moored boats by their layout support (boat deck:/boat roof:) at their layout spots (which carry their boats' moves) and are never nudged; no boat moves or is worked, so there is no `boats` block. walkers: figures painted mid-stride or carrying a load, walking along their painted direction and back (walkers_why). animals: each painted animal at its map position facing hind to fore, model and load from web/public/assets/animals/animals.json (animals_why: what stands in for an unmade coat or tack). Seats the map lacks: gen/sections/outer_road_2/seats.json, for the builder. wanted: what S4b would take from the catalogue later. No traffic.
